hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$path" in */secrets/*.yaml|*/secrets/*.yml) echo "Refusing to edit SOPS-encrypted secret: $path. Decrypt via 'sops $path' instead — direct edits will corrupt the ciphertext." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$path" in *.nix) cd /home/maksym/nix-flake && out=$(nix flake check --no-build --show-trace 2>&1); status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then echo "--- nix flake check failed (CLAUDE.md mandates eval validation) ---" >&2; echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac
